people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Arabia
people.line: A region and its inhabitants, mentioned in various contexts.

people.name: Geshem
people.line: Arab opponent of Nehemiah; tried to hinder wall rebuilding.

people.name: Horonites
people.line: A people group opposed to Nehemiah's work.

people.name: Sanballat
people.line: Governor of Samaria, opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem

people.name: Tobiah
people.line: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts

translations.web: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us, and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”
translations.bsb: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official, and Geshem the Arab heard about this, they mocked us and ridiculed us, saying, “What is this you are doing? Are you rebelling against the king?”
translations.kjv: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
translations.asv: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
